kind_note: open-source coding-agent harness: CLI, REPL, headless daemon, and Telegram bot sharing one session manager; npm package agent-afk, repo griffinwork40/agent-afk
note: Lab noted as unknown; the repo belongs to an individual maintainer (named Griffin Long in a LinkedIn search result I did not open). The date is the project's own CHANGELOG.md entry for 0.1.0, which is headed 2026-02-09 and lists 'Initial release'. It conflicts with other sources: Stork (third-party directory, opened) says 'shipped Jul 1, 2026' and lists 'Founded: June 7, 2026', and a LinkedIn search snippet says development started in March 2026, which is later than the changelog date. I did not confirm when 0.1.0 became public: the npm page returned HTTP 403, and the npm registry JSON is about 7.9M characters, so I did not reach its 'time' field. The changelog entry does not say the release was public, so 2026-02-09 may be a private or pre-public build. Before treating it as public availability, check npm's first publish time for agent-afk@0.1.0. If that is in July 2026, the release date would be 2026-07-01 per Stork, though Stork is a weaker source.
